question: 已知 $DX,DY$ 均存在，正确个数为① $E^2(XY)\le E(X^2)E(Y^2)$；② $\operatorname{Cov}^2(X,Y) > \operatorname{Cov}(X,X)\operatorname{Cov}(Y,Y)$；③ $E(|X|) \ge \sqrt{E(X^2)}$；④ $DX > E(X-a)^2$.
raw_question_text: 已知 $DX,DY$ 均存在，正确个数为① $E^2(XY)\le E(X^2)E(Y^2)$；② $\operatorname{Cov}^2(X,Y) > \operatorname{Cov}(X,X)\operatorname{Cov}(Y,Y)$；③ $E(|X|) \ge \sqrt{E(X^2)}$；④ $DX > E(X-a)^2$.
